sanskrit: indra̱ṁ viśvā̍ avīvṛdhan samu̱dravya̍casa̱ṁ gira̍ḥ | ra̱thīta̍maṁ ra̱thīnā̱ṁ vājā̍nā̱ṁ satpa̍ti̱m pati̍m ||
english: All hymns, vast as the ocean, have magnified Indra — the best charioteer among charioteers, the true lord of prizes, the sovereign of all.

sanskrit: sa̱khye ta̍ indra vā̱jino̱ mā bhe̍ma śavasas pate | tvām a̱bhi pra ṇo̍numo̱ jetā̍ra̱m apa̍rājitam ||
english: In friendship with you, O Indra, in your companionship of strength-bestowing bounty, may we not fear, O lord of might. We laud you who are the unconquered conqueror.

sanskrit: pū̱rvīr indra̍sya rā̱tayo̱ na vi da̍syanty ū̱taya̍ḥ | yadī̱ vāja̍sya̱ goma̍taḥ sto̱tṛbhyo̱ maṁha̍te ma̱gham ||
english: Indra's many gifts and his aids do not fail, whenever he bestows the wealth of cattle along with prizes upon those who praise him.

sanskrit: pu̱rām bhi̱ndur yuvā̍ ka̱vir ami̍taujā ajāyata | indro̱ viśva̍sya̱ karma̍ṇo dha̱rtā va̱jrī pu̍ruṣṭu̱taḥ ||
english: He was born as the breaker of fortresses, young and wise, of immeasurable might — Indra, the upholder of every action, the wielder of the vajra, lauded by many.

sanskrit: tvaṁ va̱lasya̱ goma̱to 'pā̍var adrivo̱ bila̍m | tvāṁ de̱vā abi̍bhyuṣas tu̱jyamā̍nāsa āviṣuḥ ||
english: You, O stone-armed one, uncovered the cave of Vala filled with cattle. The gods, themselves fearless, revealed you as you were being urged forward.

sanskrit: tavā̱haṁ śū̍ra rā̱tibhi̱ḥ praty ā̍ya̱ṁ sindhu̍m ā̱vada̍n | upā̍tiṣṭhanta girvaṇo vi̱duṣ ṭe̱ tasya̍ kā̱rava̍ḥ ||
english: By your bounties, O hero, I have approached, singing aloud, the river. Those who delight in your praises, O praise-lover, have drawn near, knowing your might.

sanskrit: mā̱yābhi̍r indra mā̱yina̱ṁ tvaṁ śuṣṇa̱m avā̍tiraḥ | vi̱duṣ ṭe̱ tasya̱ medhi̍rā̱s teṣā̱ṁ śravā̱ṁsy ut ti̍ra ||
english: By your wiles, O Indra, you have overthrown Śuṣṇa the wily. The wise who know this deed of yours — lift up their glories.

sanskrit: indra̱m īśā̍na̱m oja̍sā̱bhi stomā̍ anūṣata | sa̱hasra̱ṁ yasya̍ rā̱taya̍ u̱ta vā̱ santi̱ bhūya̍sīḥ ||
english: The praises have sung forth to Indra who rules by his might — he whose gifts are a thousand, or even more.

sanskrit: a̱gniṁ dū̱taṁ vṛ̍ṇīmahe̱ hotā̍raṁ vi̱śvave̍dasam | a̱sya ya̱jñasya̍ su̱kratu̍m ||
english: We choose Agni as our messenger, the hotar of all wisdom, the one of fine insight for this sacrifice.

sanskrit: a̱gnim-a̍gni̱ṁ havī̍mabhi̱ḥ sadā̍ havanta vi̱śpati̍m | ha̱vya̱vāha̍m purupri̱yam ||
english: They ever invoke Agni upon Agni with offerings — the lord of the house, the carrier of oblations, the one greatly beloved.

sanskrit: agne̍ de̱vām̐ i̱hā va̍ha jajñā̱no vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣe | asi̱ hotā̍ na̱ īḍya̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, being born, bring hither the gods for him who has strewn the sacred grass. You are the hotar worthy of our praise.

sanskrit: tām̐ u̍śa̱to vi bo̍dhaya̱ yad a̍gne̱ yāsi̍ dū̱tya̍m | de̱vair ā sa̍tsi ba̱rhiṣi̍ ||
english: Awaken those eager gods when you go, O Agni, on your mission as messenger. Sit down on the sacred grass with the gods.

sanskrit: ghṛtā̍havana dīdiva̱ḥ prati̍ ṣma̱ riṣa̍to daha | agne̱ tvaṁ ra̍kṣa̱svina̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, you who blaze and are invoked with ghee — burn away those who assail us. Protect us, O Agni.

sanskrit: a̱gninā̱gniḥ sam i̍dhyate ka̱vir gṛ̱hapa̍ti̱r yuvā̍ | ha̱vya̱vāḍ ju̱hvā̍syaḥ ||
english: Agni is kindled by Agni — the seer, the young lord of the household, the carrier of oblations, he whose mouth is the ladle.

sanskrit: ka̱vim a̱gnim upa̍ stuhi sa̱tyadha̍rmāṇam adhva̱re | de̱vam a̍mīva̱cāta̍nam ||
english: Praise Agni the seer, who upholds the true ordinance at the sacrifice — the god who drives away disease.

sanskrit: yas tvām a̍gne ha̱viṣpa̍tir dū̱taṁ de̍va sapa̱ryati̍ | tasya̍ sma prāvi̱tā bha̍va ||
english: Whosoever, as lord of offerings, honours you, O Agni, as his divine messenger — be his protector and helper.

sanskrit: yo a̱gniṁ de̱vavī̍taye ha̱viṣmā̍m̐ ā̱vivā̍sati | tasmai̍ pāvaka mṛḻaya ||
english: He who, bearing oblations, attends upon Agni for the enjoyment of the gods — show grace to him, O Pāvaka.

sanskrit: sa na̍ḥ pāvaka dīdi̱vo 'gne̍ de̱vām̐ i̱hā va̍ha | upa̍ ya̱jñaṁ ha̱viś ca̍ naḥ ||
english: So blaze for us, O Pāvaka Agni, and bring the gods hither to our sacrifice and our oblation.

sanskrit: sa na̱ḥ stavā̍na̱ ā bha̍ra gāya̱treṇa̱ navī̍yasā | ra̱yiṁ vī̱rava̍tī̱m iṣa̍m ||
english: Being praised by us, bring to us with the ever-new gāyatra hymn wealth rich in heroes, and nourishment.

sanskrit: agne̍ śu̱kreṇa̍ śo̱ciṣā̱ viśvā̍bhir de̱vahū̍tibhiḥ | i̱maṁ stoma̍ṁ juṣasva naḥ ||
english: O Agni, with your bright flame and with all the invocations of the gods, accept this hymn of praise from us.

sanskrit: susa̍middho na̱ ā va̍ha de̱vām̐ a̍gne ha̱viṣma̍te | hota̍ḥ pāvaka̱ yakṣi̍ ca ||
english: Well kindled, O Agni, bring the gods hither to the one who offers oblations. O hotar, O Pāvaka, worship them too.

sanskrit: madhu̍mantaṁ tanūnapād ya̱jñaṁ de̱veṣu̍ naḥ kave | a̱dyā kṛ̍ṇuhi vī̱taye̍ ||
english: O Tanūnapāt, O seer, make our sweet sacrifice a delight for the gods today.

sanskrit: narā̱śaṁsa̍m i̱ha pri̱yam a̱smin ya̱jña upa̍ hvaye | madhu̍jihvaṁ havi̱ṣkṛta̍m ||
english: I invoke here the beloved Narāśaṁsa at this sacrifice — he of honeyed tongue, formed by oblations.

sanskrit: agne̍ su̱khata̍me̱ rathe̍ de̱vām̐ ī̍ḻi̱ta ā va̍ha | asi̱ hotā̱ manu̍rhitaḥ ||
english: O Agni, on your most pleasant chariot bring hither the gods who are praised. You are the hotar established by Manu.

sanskrit: stṛ̱ṇī̱ta ba̱rhir ā̍nu̱ṣag ghṛ̱tapṛ̍ṣṭham manīṣiṇaḥ | yatrā̱mṛta̍sya̱ cakṣa̍ṇam ||
english: Let the wise strew the sacred grass in succession, ghee-backed, where is the seat of the immortal.

sanskrit: vi śra̍yantām ṛtā̱vṛdho̱ dvāro̍ de̱vīr a̍sa̱ścata̍ḥ | a̱dyā nū̱naṁ ca̱ yaṣṭa̍ve ||
english: Let the divine doors, those that augment ṛta, ever-flowing, swing open — for the worship offered today and henceforth.

sanskrit: nakto̱ṣāsā̍ su̱peśa̍sā̱smin ya̱jña upa̍ hvaye | i̱daṁ no̍ ba̱rhir ā̱sade̍ ||
english: Night and Dawn, beautifully adorned — I invoke them both at this sacrifice to sit upon our sacred grass.

sanskrit: tā su̍ji̱hvā upa̍ hvaye̱ hotā̍rā̱ daivyā̍ ka̱vī | ya̱jñaṁ no̍ yakṣatām i̱mam ||
english: I invoke the two eloquent divine hotars, seers both — may they worship this sacrifice of ours.

sanskrit: iḻā̱ sara̍svatī ma̱hī ti̱sro de̱vīr ma̍yo̱bhuva̍ḥ | ba̱rhiḥ sī̍dantv a̱sridha̍ḥ ||
english: Iḷā, Sarasvatī, and Mahī — three goddesses bestowing bliss — let them, unfailing, take their seats on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: i̱ha tvaṣṭā̍ram agri̱yaṁ vi̱śvarū̱pa̱m upa̍ hvaye | a̱smāka̍m astu̱ keva̍laḥ ||
english: I invoke here Tvaṣṭar, the foremost, of all forms — may he belong to us alone.

sanskrit: ava̍ sṛjā vanaspate̱ deva̍ de̱vebhyo̍ ha̱viḥ | pra dā̱tur a̍stu̱ ceta̍nam ||
english: O divine Vanaspati, release the oblation toward the gods. May there be discernment for the giver.

sanskrit: svāhā̍ ya̱jñaṁ kṛ̍ṇota̱nendrā̍ya̱ yajva̍no gṛ̱he | tatra̍ de̱vām̐ upa̍ hvaye ||
english: With svāhā, make the sacrifice in the house of the worshipper for Indra. There I invoke the gods.

sanskrit: aibhi̍r agne̱ duvo̱ giro̱ viśve̍bhi̱ḥ soma̍pītaye | de̱vebhi̍r yāhi̱ yakṣi̍ ca ||
english: O Agni, with these ministrations and hymns, come with all the gods for the drinking of Soma, and worship.

sanskrit: ā tvā̱ kaṇvā̍ ahūṣata gṛ̱ṇanti̍ vipra te̱ dhiya̍ḥ | de̱vebhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: The Kaṇvas have called to you; the inspired ones declare your praises. Come, O Agni, with the gods.

sanskrit: i̱ndra̱vā̱yū bṛha̱spati̍m mi̱trāgnim pū̱ṣaṇa̱m bhaga̍m | ā̱di̱tyān māru̍taṁ ga̱ṇam ||
english: Indra and Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra and Agni, Pūṣan and Bhaga, the Ādityas, and the host of Maruts.

sanskrit: pra vo̍ bhriyanta̱ inda̍vo matsa̱rā mā̍dayi̱ṣṇava̍ḥ | dra̱psā madhva̍ś camū̱ṣada̍ḥ ||
english: The Soma drops are being pressed for you — exhilarating, causing rapture, drops of sweetness that settle in the cups.

sanskrit: īḻa̍te̱ tvām a̍va̱syava̱ḥ kaṇvā̍so vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ | ha̱viṣma̍nto ara̱ṁkṛta̍ḥ ||
english: The Kaṇvas, seeking your aid, who have strewn the sacred grass, bearing offerings, fully prepared — they praise you.

sanskrit: ghṛ̱tapṛ̍ṣṭhā mano̱yujo̱ ye tvā̱ vaha̍nti̱ vahna̍yaḥ | ā de̱vān soma̍pītaye ||
english: The carriers whose backs are anointed with ghee, yoked by the mind, who convey you — they bring the gods for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: tān yaja̍trām̐ ṛtā̱vṛdho 'gne̱ patnī̍vatas kṛdhi | madhva̍ḥ sujihva pāyaya ||
english: Make those worthy of sacrifice, those augmenters of ṛta, come with their consorts, O Agni. Give them to drink of the sweet Soma, O you of good tongue.

sanskrit: ye yaja̍trā̱ ya īḍyā̱s te te̍ pibantu ji̱hvayā̍ | madho̍r agne̱ vaṣa̍ṭkṛti ||
english: Those who are worthy of sacrifice, those who are praiseworthy — let them drink by means of your tongue, O Agni, with the call of vaṣaṭ, from the sweet draught.

sanskrit: ākī̱ṁ sūrya̍sya roca̱nād viśvā̍n de̱vām̐ u̍ṣa̱rbudha̍ḥ | vipro̱ hote̱ha va̍kṣati ||
english: The inspired hotar will bring hither all the gods who awake at dawn from the luminous realm of the sun.

sanskrit: viśve̍bhiḥ so̱myam madhv agna̱ indre̍ṇa vā̱yunā̍ | pibā̍ mi̱trasya̱ dhāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: O Agni, drink the sweet Soma with all the gods, with Indra, with Vāyu, with the established ordinances of Mitra.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hotā̱ manu̍rhi̱to 'gne̍ ya̱jñeṣu̍ sīdasi | semaṁ no̍ adhva̱raṁ ya̍ja ||
english: You, O Agni, are the hotar established by Manu; you take your seat at the sacrifices. Worship this our non-violent sacrifice.

sanskrit: yu̱kṣvā hy aru̍ṣī̱ rathe̍ ha̱rito̍ deva ro̱hita̍ḥ | tābhi̍r de̱vām̐ i̱hā va̍ha ||
english: Yoke the ruddy mares to the chariot and the bay steeds, O divine Rohita. With them bring the gods hither.

sanskrit: indra̱ soma̱m piba̍ ṛ̱tunā tvā̍ viśa̱ntv inda̍vaḥ | ma̱tsa̱rāsa̱s tado̍kasaḥ ||
english: Drink the Soma in due order, O Indra; let the drops enter you — those exhilarating ones, those that are at home in that.

sanskrit: maru̍ta̱ḥ piba̍ta ṛ̱tunā̍ po̱trād ya̱jñam pu̍nītana | yū̱yaṁ hi ṣṭhā su̍dānavaḥ ||
english: O Maruts, drink in due order from the purifier's vessel; purify the sacrifice. You are, indeed, great givers.

sanskrit: a̱bhi ya̱jñaṁ gṛ̍ṇīhi no̱ gnāvo̱ neṣṭa̱ḥ piba̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ | tvaṁ hi ra̍tna̱dhā asi̍ ||
english: Celebrate our sacrifice, O Neṣṭar; drink in due order with the wives of the gods. For you are indeed the one who holds treasure.

sanskrit: agne̍ de̱vām̐ i̱hā va̍ha sā̱dayā̱ yoni̍ṣu tri̱ṣu | pari̍ bhūṣa̱ piba̍ ṛ̱tunā̍ ||
english: O Agni, bring the gods hither and seat them in the three stations. Attend on them, and drink in due order.

sanskrit: brāhma̍ṇād indra̱ rādha̍sa̱ḥ pibā̱ soma̍m ṛ̱tūm̐r anu̍ | taved dhi sa̱khyam astṛ̍tam ||
english: From the brāhmaṇa's bounty, O Indra, drink the Soma through the succession of seasons. Truly, your friendship is undiminished.

sanskrit: yu̱vaṁ dakṣa̍ṁ dhṛtavrata̱ mitrā̍varuṇa dū̱ḻabha̍m | ṛ̱tunā̍ ya̱jñam ā̍śāthe ||
english: You two, O Mitra and Varuṇa, who hold firm your vows, who guide insight that is hard to attain — you two obtain the sacrifice in due season.

sanskrit: dra̱vi̱ṇo̱dā dravi̍ṇaso̱ grāva̍hastāso adhva̱re | ya̱jñeṣu̍ de̱vam ī̍ḻate ||
english: Those who are wealthy and give wealth, pressing-stone in hand at the sacrifice, they praise the god at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: dra̱vi̱ṇo̱dā da̍dātu no̱ vasū̍ni̱ yāni̍ śṛṇvi̱re | de̱veṣu̱ tā va̍nāmahe ||
english: May Draviṇodas give us the treasures which are renowned. We shall win those among the gods.

sanskrit: dra̱vi̱ṇo̱dāḥ pi̍pīṣati ju̱hota̱ pra ca̍ tiṣṭhata | ne̱ṣṭrād ṛ̱tubhi̍r iṣyata ||
english: Draviṇodas desires to drink; pour the oblation and advance. Be sent forth through the seasons from the Neṣṭar's cup.

sanskrit: yat tvā̍ tu̱rīya̍m ṛ̱tubhi̱r dravi̍ṇodo̱ yajā̍mahe | adha̍ smā no da̱dir bha̍va ||
english: When we worship you, O Draviṇodas, as the fourth through the seasons — then indeed become a giver to us.

sanskrit: aśvi̍nā̱ piba̍ta̱m madhu̱ dīdya̍gnī śucivratā | ṛ̱tunā̍ yajñavāhasā ||
english: O Aśvins, drink the honey — you whose fire blazes, of pure vows, who carry the sacrifice in due season.

sanskrit: gārha̍patyena santya ṛ̱tunā̍ yajña̱nīr a̍si | de̱vān de̍vaya̱te ya̍ja ||
english: By the fire of the gārhapatya, O truthful one, you are the guide of the sacrifice in due season. Worship the gods for the god-devoted worshipper.

sanskrit: ā tvā̍ vahantu̱ hara̍yo̱ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṁ soma̍pītaye | indra̍ tvā̱ sūra̍cakṣasaḥ ||
english: May the bay steeds bring you, O bull among gods, for the drinking of Soma, O Indra — you who are seen by the sun.

sanskrit: i̱mā dhā̱nā ghṛ̍ta̱snuvo̱ harī̍ i̱hopa̍ vakṣataḥ | indra̍ṁ su̱khata̍me̱ rathe̍ ||
english: These grain offerings, dripping with ghee — the two bays shall bring Indra hither on his most pleasant chariot.

sanskrit: indra̍m prā̱tar ha̍vāmaha̱ indra̍m praya̱ty a̍dhva̱re | indra̱ṁ soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: We invoke Indra at dawn, we invoke Indra at the advance of the sacrifice, we invoke Indra for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: upa̍ naḥ su̱tam ā ga̍hi̱ hari̍bhir indra ke̱śibhi̍ḥ | su̱te hi tvā̱ havā̍mahe ||
english: Come to our pressed Soma, O Indra, with your flowing-maned bay steeds. For at the pressing we invoke you.

sanskrit: semaṁ na̱ḥ stoma̱m ā ga̱hy upe̱daṁ sava̍naṁ su̱tam | gau̱ro na tṛ̍ṣi̱taḥ pi̍ba ||
english: Come to this our hymn of praise, and to this pressing of the Soma. Drink like a thirsty bull.

sanskrit: i̱me somā̍sa̱ inda̍vaḥ su̱tāso̱ adhi̍ ba̱rhiṣi̍ | tām̐ i̍ndra̱ saha̍se piba ||
english: These are the Soma drops, pressed and set out upon the sacred grass. Drink them, O Indra, for your strength.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ te̱ stomo̍ agri̱yo hṛ̍di̱spṛg a̍stu̱ śaṁta̍maḥ | athā̱ soma̍ṁ su̱tam pi̍ba ||
english: May this hymn, foremost of all, touch your heart and be most pleasing to you. Then drink the pressed Soma.

sanskrit: viśva̱m it sava̍naṁ su̱tam indro̱ madā̍ya gacchati | vṛ̱tra̱hā soma̍pītaye ||
english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, goes to every pressing of the Soma that has been pressed, for exhilaration and for drinking.

sanskrit: semaṁ na̱ḥ kāma̱m ā pṛ̍ṇa̱ gobhi̱r aśvai̍ḥ śatakrato | stavā̍ma tvā svā̱dhya̍ḥ ||
english: Fill up this our desire with cattle and horses, O you of a hundred powers. We who are devoted to deep thought praise you.

sanskrit: indrā̱varu̍ṇayor a̱haṁ sa̱mrājo̱r ava̱ ā vṛ̍ṇe | tā no̍ mṛḻāta ī̱dṛśe̍ ||
english: I take refuge with Indra and Varuṇa, the two universal sovereigns. May they two show us grace in such need as this.

sanskrit: gantā̍rā̱ hi stho 'va̍se̱ hava̱ṁ vipra̍sya̱ māva̍taḥ | dha̱rtārā̍ carṣaṇī̱nām ||
english: For you two come to the aid of the call of the inspired poet who praises you. You are the upholders of the peoples.

sanskrit: a̱nu̱kā̱maṁ ta̍rpayethā̱m indrā̍varuṇa rā̱ya ā | tā vā̱ṁ nedi̍ṣṭham īmahe ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, gratify us to our heart's desire with wealth. We approach you two most closely.

sanskrit: yu̱vāku̱ hi śacī̍nāṁ yu̱vāku̍ sumatī̱nām | bhū̱yāma̍ vāja̱dāvnā̍m ||
english: May we be among those whose mighty deeds belong to you two, whose benevolent thoughts belong to you two, among those who receive gifts of prize.

sanskrit: indra̍ḥ sahasra̱dāvnā̱ṁ varu̍ṇa̱ḥ śaṁsyā̍nām | kratu̍r bhavaty u̱kthya̍ḥ ||
english: Indra becomes the inspiration worthy of hymn among those who give a thousandfold; Varuṇa becomes so among those worthy of praise.

sanskrit: tayo̱r id ava̍sā va̱yaṁ sa̱nema̱ ni ca̍ dhīmahi | syād u̱ta pra̱reca̍nam ||
english: By the protection of those two alone may we gain victory and lay low our foes. May there be an overflowing gift.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇa vām a̱haṁ hu̱ve ci̱trāya̱ rādha̍se | a̱smān su ji̱gyuṣa̍s kṛtam ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, I invoke you two for brilliant bounty. Make us thoroughly victorious.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇa̱ nū nu vā̱ṁ siṣā̍santīṣu dhī̱ṣv ā | a̱smabhya̱ṁ śarma̍ yacchatam ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, now at this moment in the thoughts that are striving to reach you — grant shelter to us.

sanskrit: pra vā̍m aśnotu suṣṭu̱tir indrā̍varuṇa̱ yāṁ hu̱ve | yām ṛ̱dhāthe̍ sa̱dhastu̍tim ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, may the perfect praise which I call upon reach you — the joint hymn of praise at which you two rejoice.

sanskrit: so̱māna̱ṁ svara̍ṇaṁ kṛṇu̱hi bra̍hmaṇas pate | ka̱kṣīva̍nta̱ṁ ya au̍śi̱jaḥ ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, make the Soma drinker resound — Kakṣīvat, the son of Uśij.

sanskrit: yo re̱vān yo a̍mīva̱hā va̍su̱vit pu̍ṣṭi̱vardha̍naḥ | sa na̍ḥ siṣaktu̱ yas tu̱raḥ ||
english: He who is wealthy, who drives away disease, who finds prosperity, who augments well-being — may that swift one attend upon us.

sanskrit: mā na̱ḥ śaṁso̱ ara̍ruṣo dhū̱rtiḥ praṇa̱ṅ martya̍sya | rakṣā̍ ṇo brahmaṇas pate ||
english: May the harmful intent of a malicious mortal not overcome us. Protect us, O Bṛhaspati.

sanskrit: sa ghā̍ vī̱ro na ri̍ṣyati̱ yam indro̱ brahma̍ṇa̱s pati̍ḥ | somo̍ hi̱noti̱ martya̍m ||
english: That hero truly does not come to harm whom Indra and Bṛhaspati and Soma urge forward.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tam bra̍hmaṇas pate̱ soma̱ indra̍ś ca̱ martya̍m | dakṣi̍ṇā pā̱tv aṁha̍saḥ ||
english: You, O Bṛhaspati, and Soma, and Indra — together with Dakṣiṇā guard that mortal from distress.

sanskrit: sada̍sa̱s pati̱m adbhu̍tam pri̱yam indra̍sya̱ kāmya̍m | sa̱nim me̱dhām a̍yāsiṣam ||
english: I have approached the wondrous lord of the assembly, the beloved and dear to Indra, seeking from him wisdom and intelligence.

sanskrit: yasmā̍d ṛ̱te na sidhya̍ti ya̱jño vi̍pa̱ścita̍ś ca̱na | sa dhī̱nāṁ yoga̍m invati ||
english: Without whom the sacrifice does not succeed, not even that of the wise man — he, Bṛhaspati, controls the yoking of inspired thoughts.

sanskrit: ād ṛ̍dhnoti ha̱viṣkṛ̍ti̱m prāñca̍ṁ kṛṇoty adhva̱ram | hotrā̍ de̱veṣu̍ gacchati ||
english: He brings to completion the preparation of offerings, makes the sacrifice proceed forward; the hotrā rite goes to the gods.

sanskrit: narā̱śaṁsa̍ṁ su̱dhṛṣṭa̍ma̱m apa̍śyaṁ sa̱pratha̍stamam | di̱vo na sadma̍makhasam ||
english: I have beheld Narāśaṁsa most bold and most widely famed, shining like the dwelling-place of heaven.

sanskrit: prati̱ tyaṁ cāru̍m adhva̱raṁ go̍pī̱thāya̱ pra hū̍yase | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: You are invoked for the protection of this dear sacrifice. Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: na̱hi de̱vo na martyo̍ ma̱has tava̱ kratu̍m pa̱raḥ | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: No god, no mortal, surpasses your great might. Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ye ma̱ho raja̍so vi̱dur viśve̍ de̱vāso̍ a̱druha̍ḥ | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who know the great firmament, all the gods without deceit — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ya u̱grā a̱rkam ā̍nṛ̱cur anā̍dhṛṣṭāsa̱ oja̍sā | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who in their might have reached toward the sun's hymn, irresistible in power — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ye śu̱bhrā gho̱rava̍rpasaḥ sukṣa̱trāso̍ ri̱śāda̍saḥ | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who are brilliant, of terrible forms, lords of fine dominion, destroyers of enemies — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ye nāka̱syādhi̍ roca̱ne di̱vi de̱vāsa̱ āsa̍te | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who sit as gods in heaven upon the shining vault of the sky — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ya ī̱ṅkhaya̍nti̱ parva̍tān ti̱raḥ sa̍mu̱dram a̍rṇa̱vam | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who cause the mountains to tremble, across the surging ocean's flood — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: ā ye ta̱nvanti̍ ra̱śmibhi̍s ti̱raḥ sa̍mu̱dram oja̍sā | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: Who stretch their rays of light with might across the ocean — come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̍ pū̱rvapī̍taye sṛ̱jāmi̍ so̱myam madhu̍ | ma̱rudbhi̍r agna̱ ā ga̍hi ||
english: I release the sweet Soma drink to you for the first drinking. Come, O Agni, with the Maruts.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ de̱vāya̱ janma̍ne̱ stomo̱ vipre̍bhir āsa̱yā | akā̍ri ratna̱dhāta̍maḥ ||
english: This hymn of praise has been fashioned with devotion by the inspired seers for the divine birth — the most treasure-laden of hymns.

sanskrit: ya indrā̍ya vaco̱yujā̍ tata̱kṣur mana̍sā̱ harī̍ | śamī̍bhir ya̱jñam ā̍śata ||
english: Those who, for Indra, fashioned by mind the two bays joined by speech — the Ṛbhus — they attained the sacrifice with their labours.

sanskrit: takṣa̱n nāsa̍tyābhyā̱m pari̍jmānaṁ su̱khaṁ ratha̍m | takṣa̍n dhe̱nuṁ sa̍ba̱rdughā̍m ||
english: They fashioned for the two Nāsatyas a chariot that travels everywhere and is pleasant. They fashioned the cow that yields milk in abundance.

sanskrit: yuvā̍nā pi̱tarā̱ puna̍ḥ sa̱tyama̍ntrā ṛjū̱yava̍ḥ | ṛ̱bhavo̍ vi̱ṣṭy a̍krata ||
english: The Ṛbhus, with true incantations and straight-going, made the two parents youthful again; they accomplished it through their skill.

sanskrit: saṁ vo̱ madā̍so agma̱tendre̍ṇa ca ma̱rutva̍tā | ā̱di̱tyebhi̍ś ca̱ rāja̍bhiḥ ||
english: Your intoxicating Soma-draughts have come together, along with Indra accompanied by the Maruts, and with the royal Ādityas.

sanskrit: u̱ta tyaṁ ca̍ma̱saṁ nava̱ṁ tvaṣṭu̍r de̱vasya̱ niṣkṛ̍tam | aka̍rta ca̱tura̱ḥ puna̍ḥ ||
english: And they fashioned again into four that single cup made by the divine Tvaṣṭar — making one into four.

sanskrit: te no̱ ratnā̍ni dhattana̱ trir ā sāptā̍ni sunva̱te | eka̍m-ekaṁ suśa̱stibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Do you set treasures upon us — thrice seven in number — for the one who presses Soma, one by one with your perfect praises.

sanskrit: adhā̍rayanta̱ vahna̱yo 'bha̍janta sukṛ̱tyayā̍ | bhā̱gaṁ de̱veṣu̍ ya̱jñiya̍m ||
english: The Ṛbhus, as divine bearers, sustained all; by their excellent deeds they obtained a share worthy of sacrifice among the gods.
